stats_correlate

ground 0

load "spice/resistor.osdi"

model resistor sp_resistor
model isource isource

parameters a__z=agauss(0, 1, 1) a=(1) + (100m)*((1e0)*a__z) b__z=agauss(0, 1, 1) b=(2) + ((2)*(200m)/100)*((6e-1)*a__z + (8e-1)*b__z) c=agauss(3, 300m, 1)

r1 (x 0) resistor r=a+b+c
i1 (0 x) isource dc=1e-3

control
  options rawfile="binary"
  analysis op1 op
endc
